quests.title: Yata Kouki's Order of Ore

dialogue.sit: You wanted some White Iron Chunks?

dialogue.t: You can't sharpen your blade if it goes blunt in battle. So, best to have Mr. Amenoma make me a shiny new one well in advance.
Have you taken on my commission? If so, I guess you've got those 5 White Iron Chunks.
Thanks a million. Please take this as a small token of my gratitude.

quests.description: Narukami Island’s Yata Kouki requests 5 White Iron Chunks.
